blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Heat indices in eight areas across the country are forecast to reach dangerous levels on Wednesday, Nov. 18, according to the state weather bureau. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) classifies heat indices ranging from 42°C to 51°C as dangerous. It warned that exposure to these conditions increases the risk of heat cramps and heat exhaustion, which could progress to heat stroke.
